title: Add option to change step size for brightness changes via standard scroll or keyboard shortcut
line: Energy Saving's advanced settings now have a "Brightness change step" that sets how much brightness keys and scrolling over the brightness widget change the screen brightness.
explanation: PowerDevil's screen brightness logic always aimed for 20 steps (5% each) for brightness keys and for wheel scrolling over the Brightness and Color widget, both of which go through the daemon's AdjustBrightnessStep. Shift gives 1% steps, but on some laptops Shift+brightness key arrives as Shift+F-key, and there was no way to pick another regular step like the volume step in the Sound settings. The change adds a BrightnessStep entry (1-20%, default 5%) to powerdevilrc's [General] group, a "Brightness change step" spin box under Other Settings on the Energy Saving advanced page, and makes the screen brightness logic use 100/step steps; the daemon applies it on start and whenever the settings page is applied, with no restart.

commits.message:
daemon, kcm: add a setting for the screen brightness change step

Brightness keys and scrolling over the Brightness and Color widget
always changed the brightness by 5%. Add a "Brightness change step"
setting to the advanced power settings, like the one for volume.

BUG: 432366

media.caption: Advanced Power Settings on master: no way to change the brightness step
New "Brightness change step" spin box under Other Settings, here set to 2%
Master: one press of the brightness-up key from 50% goes to 55%
With the step set to 2% and applied: one press from 50% goes to 52%
